canonicalMutationReview.registrationPolicy: Do not count mutants against source absent from the verification head; register after integration and require an executed exact-head kill.

postal: stronger authenticated lifecycle state cannot be overwritten by a later lower-rank event
BOUNCED cannot regress to DELAYED or SENT
lifecycle evidence strength must be compared before timestamp tie-breaking
payment: external customer acceptance or rejection must carry customerRef matching the fulfilment customerRef
wrong-customer acceptance cannot create accepted-delivery truth
unbound acceptance cannot create accepted-delivery truth
genome: repository-candidate corpus evidence older than 30 days fails closed
skill-body corpus evidence older than 30 days fails closed
normalized-record evidence older than 30 days fails closed

truthRules: Zero-step jobs with runner_id=0 are environment startup failures, not source failures.
No mutation kill is counted unless mutated source executes and the intended test fails for the intended guard.
Exact-head proof is SHA-scoped and does not transfer to a later receipt commit.
No commercial truth changes without durable real external evidence.
nextVerificationActions: Keep PR #321 draft until at least one exact-head verification run executes real steps.
When Postal, Payment, and Genome changes reach an integration candidate, add their high-consequence guards to the canonical mutation inventory and require executed kills.
Require exact-head PostgreSQL execution before concurrency claims and exact-head browser execution before browser-path claims.
Do not generate repeated runner-noise solely to obtain another identical zero-step failure; re-check naturally on the next advanced head.
